- Dried goji/chili: ~350 kcal/100 g (dried goji) → 2 g ≈ 7 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A small side salad with about 25 g of food and roughly 20 kcal is plausible for a plate covering only ~12% of its area. Totals: ~27 g, ~18–20 kcal. Olive oil or dressing is not visible, so none is included.
